name: research-paper-factory
description: Deterministic-envelope multi-agent academic research paper pipeline (IEEE/ACM SE & Systems)

quotaWindow.resetNote: Claude quota resets Saturday afternoon PST (2026-11-28 15:00 PST). Automatically enabled after reset; falls back to codex/cursor/antigravity before reset.

coordinator.title: 研究总控官 (Coordinator)
redlines: Enforce 4 human gates; never bypass auditor or verifier failures.

scout.title: 文献官 (Scout)
redlines: Every BibTeX entry MUST come from an API response with DOI/arXiv/URL.
Never write BibTeX from LLM memory.
Prefer peer-reviewed venue editions over preprints when both exist.

architect.title: 系统实现官 (Implementation Engineer)
redlines: Harness and metric definitions freeze after Gate 1.
Deterministic seed control and SHA-256 dataset/code provenance required.

runner.title: 实验官 (Runner)
redlines: Cannot modify eval harness or metric definitions.
Cannot invent ad-hoc runs outside plan.md without human approval.
Every run writes immutable manifest.json (git_commit, harness_sha256, dataset_sha256, seed, command).

auditor.title: 对账官 (Deterministic Auditor)
redlines: Zero LLM involvement in number computation or rounding.
Every LaTeX macro MUST trace to a sealed run_id and manifest checksum.
Block pipeline on any mismatch, missing seed, or unverified run.

writer.title: 写作官 (Writer)
redlines: Zero hand-typed experimental numbers; reference generated/numbers.tex macros exclusively.
Cite only verified keys present in literature/refs.bib.
Never fabricate or promise unexecuted experiments.

verifier.title: 引用与一致性核验官 (Citation & Claim Verifier)
redlines: 100% existence verification via Crossref/OpenAlex/arXiv.
Flag preprint ratio > 25% (IEEE integrity guardrail).
Block review stage if any undefined citation or unbacked numerical claim exists.

reviewer.title: 跨模型审稿官 (Cross-Model Reviewer)
reviewer.rubric: ACM SIGSOFT Empirical Standards + IEEE SEIP/ICSE Review Criteria
redlines: Reviewer model family MUST differ from Writer model family.
Review suggestions may NOT auto-trigger experiment fabrication; new runs require Gate 3 human approval.
Maximum 3 text-only revision rounds.

typesetter.title: 排版与合规官 (Typesetter)
redlines: AI disclosure paragraph MUST be generated strictly from AI_USAGE.md.
Zero undefined citations or LaTeX errors; respect venue page limits.
